desc: 小脸立体缝版型珊瑚粉碎花亲肤，无鼻夹不压脸，宽扁耳带不勒耳
leaf: 小脸型布面立体缝制碎花印花四层口罩
name: 珊瑚粉碎花小脸型立体缝制口罩款

shots.intent: 首屏用硬边薄荷海报场与品红画框把珊瑚粉碎花立体缝制口罩本体推到眼前，一眼看清小脸型版型与碎花布面，赢得详情页继续下滑。
shots.textZone: upper water-mint #A9DDD6 band for headline plus one sub-line; a row of three capsule chips beneath

shots.intent: 用三格日常佩戴困扰（大码滑脸、细绳勒耳、布面贴口）放大小脸型人群的真实不适，制造换小码立体缝版型的动机，只讲佩戴体感不讲病理。
shots.textZone: headline across the top, one short capsule label under each of the three slots

shots.intent: 俯视同框对照普通单层布罩与本款的复合布层结构，用箭头气流图讲清有无密实芯层的差异，把结构差异转成可买的理由。
shots.textZone: one header per side plus one capsule chip per side

shots.intent: 低角度侧拍展示立体缝制穹顶在口鼻前撑起的呼吸空间与三条拼缝的受力走向，把三维分体讲成看得见的版型。
shots.textZone: headline upper-left in the clean indigo corner, two short labels on the bottom card

shots.intent: 高角度逐层分离四条布片，让买家看懂外层印花布、中间密实芯层与贴肤层的用料层次，把做工成本讲成可见证据。
shots.textZone: headline top-left, four short material labels in the right column, one blank seal band

shots.intent: 正侧微距展示宽扁编织耳带的织纹、贴片受力点与布面热切包边，回应勒耳和脱线的做工疑虑。
把小码立体口罩放进真实上学路的自然光场景，让家长一眼看到尺寸比例与佩戴形态，完成情境代入。
shots.textZone: clean upper band for one headline plus one short line

shots.intent: 把版型、布面、耳带、包边、轻量和收纳六点拆成统一花核图标阵，形成结构化记忆并承接留白资质带。
shots.textZone: headline top-left, one short capsule label under each of the six icon cards, one blank placeholder band

shots.intent: 俯视平铺同款不同布色的四只口罩，让买家一次看清可选配色并判断小码尺寸比例。
shots.textZone: three short labels along the bottom caption band

shots.intent: 用三条回顾要点、留白尺码槽与一枚短按钮收口，推动加购且不依赖任何资质或数值承诺。
shots.textZone: headline at the top, three short checklist lines on the card, one empty size slot row, one rounded raspberry button beneath

style.backgroundSystem: hard-edged poster fields butt-joined with straight seams and no gradient: water-mint #A9DDD6, periwinkle-indigo #5B64CF carrying a 45-degree tonal pinstripe set at 8% opacity, and pale lilac #DCDFF5 panels; every screen is ringed by one inset raspberry #E23E77 hairline picture frame standing 3% off the canvas edge; one oversized Latin display word is cropped by both side edges at 15% opacity as background lettering only; chalk-white cards #FDFCFD lift off the field on one hard 6px block offset shadow, never a diffuse blur; no stepped 3D plinth, no candy rounded colour block, no scalloped edging, no paper-sticker collage, no flecked oat band layout, no clinical or tiled space
style.direction: cool poster-block child-size sewn-fabric daily-wear ecommerce
style.iconSystem: line-and-solid six-petal flower-core glyph with three orbiting dots, drawn as a 2px raspberry #E23E77 outline over warm lilac-grey #E8E4EC fill, each icon paired with a raspberry #E23E77 capsule chip carrying a small flower-gear target token at its tail, identical outline weight and chip radius everywhere; never a thin-line circle on a white disc, never a filled disc inside an arch-topped card, never a bare two-tone silhouette without a container, never a solid rounded-square badge
style.lightingSystem: cool daylight-balanced 7200K studio light, back-right 45-degree rim key plus one broad overhead fill, short neutral mauve-grey #CFC9DC shadows always falling to the front-left, thin clean rim glow along the crown edge, no light streak, no diagonal glare band, no specular hotspot, no warm cast, identical direction across the whole set

style.presentationRules: keep the small-size sewn 3D dome body, the coral-pink #F4959C cotton ground with its all-over white #FFF3F1 micro five-petal flower-and-dot print at identical scale, orientation and density, the vertical centre seam plus two angled side seams, the wire-free shaped crown with two shallow side notches, the heat-sealed bound coral edge and the flat wide white #FFFFFF woven elastic ear loops with their tab anchors; no nose clip, no valve, no exhalation port, no logo or wordmark on the body; identical angle family, scale and centring in every shot
style.surfaceSystem: matte poster paper boards in water-mint #A9DDD6, periwinkle-indigo #5B64CF and pale lilac #DCDFF5, raised chalk-white card planes #FDFCFD, one lilac #DCDFF5 matte riser block used as the only stage furniture; real printed cotton twill with a visible weave and heat-sealed bound edge on the product itself
style.typography: one heavy oblique condensed Chinese sans used at two weights only, a bold oblique for display and a medium for body and labels; three-layer in-image copy wrapped in 「」, headline at most 15 chars in deep ink-plum #2C2438 or chalk-white #FDFCFD depending on the field underneath, two to six short capsule labels, the single cropped Latin background word is the only Latin allowed, no letterspaced Latin kicker line and no rotated vertical Latin label, no dense body text, no figures rendered by the model
